name: ARK
fix_description: In autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens, add require(block.timestamp >= lastLpBurnTime + lpBurnFrequency) to enforce cooldown between burns. Without this check, anyone can call it repeatedly to drain the LP pair.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a complex multi-contract chain involving nested Aave and Balancer flash loans, Curve liquidity manipulation, Beefy vault shares as collateral, a lending market borrow/liquidation flow, and a read-only reentrancy trigger via receive(). Reproducing it requires deep protocol-specific understanding of pricing/accounting interactions across Curve, Beefy, and the lending market, well beyond a straightforward single-bug PoC.
